You can embed widgets, such as Gtk::Buttons, in the
text. Each such child widget needs a ChildAnchor.
ChildAnchors are associated with iterators. For
instance, to create a child anchor at a particular position, use
Gtk::TextBuffer::create_child_anchor():

Then, to add a widget at that position, use
Gtk::TextView::add_child_at_anchor():
